metadata.name: Old Wardrobe
metadata.description:
Use the Old Wardrobe to customize the visual of Isaac.
- Appears in the first room on each floor.
- You can equip or desequip the costumes of the items you have, or the transformation (Guppy, Mom, etc...)
- You can't desequip all the flying costumes you have (blue icon).
- Modded costumes are not affected by this mod.
- Works in multiplayer too.
- use the DROP button on the keyboard to exit the wardrobe menu (defaut key is CTRL)
- the timer of the game is stopped when using the wardrobe : take your time to dress
- Use the Pill button to mark up to 64 non-flying costumes ; they will be available on new runs.
